thread:
eli: quick proposal - shrink our fallback footprint. emit a compact 'fallback_compact' event per degraded request (reason enum + route + short prompt_hash + model_version) and keep verbose traces sampled only for internal audit/forensic. goal: let customers understand "why" at an aggregate level without exposing infra.

priya: +1 on reducing noise, but worried about leaking routing semantics. what goes in the reason enum? need careful wording.

eli: thinking: reason values = latency_quota, model_error, capacity_pressure, policy_quarantine. these are intentionally coarse. no hostnames, no node ids, no shard ids.

sam: implementation sketch: compact events always emitted to a per-customer compact_topic (kafka). full traces written to an internal trace store when sampled. include a prompt_hash (sha256 first 12 chars) so we can deterministically replay if obliged by audit. example compact payload (one-line): {event_type:fallback_compact, cust:c-42, reason:capacity_pressure, route:text-gen, prompt_hash:7a3f9b..., model:v2.1, ts:4999991234}

priya: replayability question - if regulators ask for "all fallbacks" over a week, sampling won't suffice. do we provide a replay-kit: keep compact events + retain raw prompts behind strict RBAC for X days and allow legal requests?

eli: yes, plan: compact events retained in public-facing analytics (hashed) for 90d. raw prompts and full traces retained internally under stricter retention (eg 30d) and only accessible through an audited workflow. to reconstruct inputs we store deterministic seeds + model snapshot references.

sam: sampling policy idea: baseline full-trace sample_rate = 0.2% per-customer, auto-increase to 2% for anomaly windows, emergency cap 10% but gated by ops approval. compact events unconditionally emitted but are tiny. also add per-customer throttle: max_compact_per_minute = 1000.

priya: UX in Console - surface top-line "fallback rate by reason" + a small donut breakdown and a "Request forensic replay" button (RBAC gated). for customers who opt-in, we can add a header opt-in to API responses. otherwise keep `fallback_reason` out of normal responses.

eli: API opt-in mechanism proposal: clients add header X-Redwood-Fallback: verbose. Console toggle required for account-level consent. That avoids accidental dependency.

security-bot: security-checklist reminder: run privacy review on the prompt_hash scheme (collision/uniqueness), confirm no PII leaks in compact payloads, add audit logs for any replay access.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-1507 "compact fallback events + replay-kit + consent toggle" and assigned to @sam and @priya.

sam: next steps - I'll draft compact schema + kafka topic config and a minimal producer lib. will include pseudoconfig: compact.sample_rate: always emit, trace.sample_rate: 0.002 baseline, spike_multiplier:10, max_burst:2000/min.

priya: I'll mock Console panels and consent copy, and document RBAC flow for replay requests.

eli: security review & legal touchpoint - I'll coordinate. let's sync in 48h. :thumbsup:

sam: WIP PR coming tomorrow.

eli: thanks everyone. aim: minimal public surface, deterministic replay path for audits, and clear opt-in for richer per-request signals.
